original_test_intent: Verify that Del at the displayed POST hint enters the intended BIOS Setup on the identified host and that the shown BIOS version and release date match the approved reference.
original_method: Bind host/console and expected values, approve one reboot, capture the POST hint, have an operator press only Del at the correct time, capture menu plus version/date, then exit without saving and verify normal boot.
manual_activity: Human operator must focus the correct pre-OS console, press Del at the actual prompt, visually verify the intended menu and version/date, and exit without saving.
required_inputs: Expected BIOS version/release date and intended setup menu
Physical keyboard/display or validated BMC/KVM/SOL path
safety_requirements: Press only Del at the prompt
Do not change or save settings
Stop on wrong menu, unreadable values or recovery failure
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Report observations without claiming key action or verdict
engineer_actions: Exit without saving and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states ordinary SSH cannot prove POST-time Del or the rendered BIOS Setup information.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the operator-driven Del workflow through a physical or validated pre-OS console; automation may preserve/correlate evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Del, prompt timing, version/date, BIOS Setup entry and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture one continuous sequence from POST hint through Del, menu/value evidence and safe no-save exit, tied to target identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative values, console focus and recovery traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; remote console is input/evidence transport, not an OS substitute.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Timing or focus errors can reach the wrong screen or miss the prompt.

project_override_considerations: Project may approve physical or remote console, but must retain Del-specific timing, readable version/date and safe no-save exit evidence.
expected_evidence: Timestamped POST hint and Del action

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require Del-driven BIOS Setup entry plus readable/correct POST information.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual purpose is clear; reference, console/operator and reboot approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes both the hotkey transition and version/date oracle auditable while preventing wrong-host or unsafe-save evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Acceptance depends on prompt-timed human input and direct observation of a pre-OS UI. Remote KVM may carry the action but does not eliminate human timing and visual interpretation, so MANUAL ONLY remains correct.
